name: USB-C socket (GCT USB4105)
summary: 16-pin USB-C socket for the edge of a board. The plug needs a 9 x 3.2 mm slot with rounded ends.
source: GCT USB4105-GF-A drawing, revision B4: body 8.94 mm wide, 7.35 mm deep and 3.31 mm tall on the board, mouth 8.34 x 2.56 mm with fully rounded ends, front flush with the board edge. The 9.0 x 3.2 mm slot leaves about 0.35 mm round the plug shell. The plug moulding can be up to 6.5 mm tall, so with a wall thicker than about 1 mm either bring the socket right up to the wall or add a 12.4 x 6.6 mm relief on the outside.

keepouts.label: Room for the plug and its cable

electrical.note: Rated 5 A across the VBUS pins. A plain cable gives 5 V at up to 3 A; higher voltages need USB Power Delivery at both ends.
